title: Reflected access to browser network APIs bypassed the registry gate

reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation check returned pass for reflected fetch access, invocation, and descriptor lookup.
reproduction.afterFix: Static reflected access or invocation of fetch, WebSocket, EventSource, XMLHttpRequest, Image, Audio, sendBeacon, and Axios request methods fails the source-isolation gate; Reflect.construct of network constructors and remote image/audio sources is rejected.

rootCause: The AST gate resolved direct calls and ordinary aliases but did not interpret Reflect.get, Reflect.apply, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor, or Reflect.construct when their static targets resolved to outbound network APIs.
remediation: Resolve static global-object and method aliases, inspect reflected target/property pairs and constructor calls, and reject network-capable reflection without executing resource source.
